answer: Paper identities fail a moving-air test they cannot share. An applicant stakes 2.80 POA and books one 7-minute bay in a 24-lane spiral walkway. A calibrated zephyr blower holds 3.6 m/s while they splice a 14-cm dyed thread onto a rotating drum keyed to their pubkey and the epoch seed. A farm of 160 clones would need 448 POA and 160 exclusive bays in the same hour. Graders replay blower RPM from the seed and match dye lot plus splice length to the drum log. A reused bay, a slack splice, or airflow off by 0.12 m/s slashes 52% and benches that walkway for 2 epochs.
